theses.subject: Food & Beverage
theses.thesis: Among eligible scorable themes, Food & Beverage has the highest durability_bar (0.82), a trend Hurst tag, broad breadth (0.9), and no crowding flag. It appears to be a domestic demand safe haven with momentum rank 6, not extreme, but structurally sound in a mean-reverting market where trend-gate eligibility is the main risk framework. This does not predict returns; it simply puts a durable, broad-trend theme in the eligible set for a disciplined trend-following posture.
